answer: An honest proof costs 85 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 517 of them, which totals 43945 POA. Every applicant faces the same trial, Glove packer lambskin mark buttoned onto the dye vat, and every verdict reads the same way: each lambskin is a measured glove yield plus a glover's signature. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Read the nadir first: if it holds, read the glacier; if that holds, read the willow; a farm fails at the second step and never reaches the third. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
